title: QBIND Public DevNet Release-Artifact Manifest
description: Canonical, publish-safe manifest describing a single qbind-node public DevNet release artifact built with canonical injected provenance (Run 383/384). Records the exact injected build inputs, the release-binary SHA-256, the ELF BuildID, the qbind_node_build_info metric build_id/git_commit, toolchain, target, lockfile state, and verification commands. Docs/artifact only: it embeds no binary blob, no secret, no private path/hostname/endpoint, no raw log, and no raw /metrics dump.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version (semver of this schema contract).

package_name.description: Stable name of this manifest package.

package_version.description: Version of the manifest package contents.

environment.description: Deployment environment the artifact targets. DevNet only.

git_commit_full.description: Full 40-hex git commit of the source tree, if it can be captured safely. Optional; omit or set null when a git-less / source-tarball build cannot determine it.

git_commit_short.description: Short git commit of the source tree (git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD), or 'unknown' when unavailable.

injected_QBIND_GIT_COMMIT.description: The canonical QBIND_GIT_COMMIT value injected at build time (bridged into qbind_node_build_info git_commit by crates/qbind-node/build.rs).

injected_QBIND_BUILD_ID.description: The canonical, low-cardinality, non-secret QBIND_BUILD_ID release id injected at build time. Never derived from git or the ELF; intentionally NOT the ELF BuildID.

binary_path.description: Repository-relative path of the covered release binary. Must not be an absolute path.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the built release binary.

elf_build_id.description: ELF .note.gnu.build-id of the release binary (readelf -n). A linker-computed binary identity; a SEPARATE plane from metric_build_id. Empty string only if readelf is unavailable.

metric_build_id.description: The build_id label rendered by the live qbind_node_build_info /metrics scrape. Equals injected_QBIND_BUILD_ID for a canonical injected build. Must differ from elf_build_id.

metric_git_commit.description: The git_commit label rendered by the live qbind_node_build_info /metrics scrape. Equals injected_QBIND_GIT_COMMIT for a canonical injected build.

toolchain.description: Recorded rustc / cargo versions used for the reference build.

target_triple.description: Target triple of the reference build (default host target; no --target override).

cargo_lock_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed root Cargo.lock consumed with --locked (proves the pinned dependency graph).

build_command.description: Exact release build command line with injected provenance env prefix.

reproducibility_scope.description: Honest, bounded reproducibility scope. same-host / per-input only; explicitly NOT cross-host and NOT SLSA-grade.

reference.description: Pointer to the Run 383 same-input reproducibility evidence this scope references (not overclaimed as cross-host/SLSA).

generated_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp when this manifest was generated (ISO-8601, Zulu).

source_tree_state.description: Source tree cleanliness at build time.

non_claims.description: Explicit negative readiness claims. Every field must be true (the artifact makes none of these claims).

verification_commands.description: Operator-runnable verification commands (repository-relative; no absolute path, hostname, or secret). Reproduce the manifest's binary SHA-256, ELF BuildID, and live metric labels.

artifact_safety_label.description: Standing safety label for every artifact this manifest describes.
artifact_safety_label.const: experimental · resettable · no value · no MainNet readiness claim · no C4/C5 closure claim
